messages:
maria_support: Customer reported a sudden spike in API 429s this morning, plus missing entries in their audit log for provisioning events. ticket #SD-4721. Can infra/security take a look?

dan_infra: Thanks, looking. Customer tenant: acct-74b2. We see a burst of retry traffic around 08:12 UTC and a bunch of failed SCIM create requests returning 500s. Also seeing KMS decrypt warnings in the runtime logs.

lee_security: Can you paste the runtime error lines? KMS errors could explain missing audit events if the message pipeline dropped items.

maria_support: Pasting clipped logs from the customer's timeline: ```2026-03-15T08:12:14Z runtime[goroutine=44]: decrypting key failed: kms:Decrypt error=AccessDenied key=projects/secret/... status=403``` and ```scim-service: user create -> 500, upstream error: missing-audit-entry```

sara_eng-iam: That 403 from KMS suggests the CEK (customer envelope key) access policy was rejected. But unusual because this tenant's key policy hasn't changed per our records. Did we have a rotation or backfill job running?

dan_infra: We had a scheduled key-rotation backfill last night for older HSM-backed keys (internal job id: backfill-026). It touched the same key namespace. I will check job logs for failures.

ops-bot: incident-created: INC-2026-0315-01 (auto) — label=investigate-kms-scim, priority=high, owner=dan_infra

lee_security: Also flagging for a least-privilege review: SCIM provisioning role mappings for acct-74b2 are unexpectedly broad (role: tenant-admin applied to service-account scim-sync). If that service account lost KMS decrypt perms temporarily, it could explain retries and duplicate creations when retries succeeded.

maria_support: Customer reports duplicated users and a billing spike due to repeated provisioning attempts. They want hotfix and explanation, plus retention details for the ephemeral audit gap.

sara_eng-iam: Repro steps I'm running locally: 1) create short-lived service token for scim-sync 2) call provisioning endpoint with malformed attribute to trigger 500 3) simulate replay with concurrent retries. Command: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"userName":"test-repro","externalId":"replay-1"}'```

dan_infra: From the backfill-026 logs: one worker returned KMS RPC timeouts and then retried after requeue. There's a race that caused some audit events to be dropped from the archiver queue when the decrypt step returned transient 403/504. I'm escalating to HSM vendor for deeper traces.

lee_security: Action items: (1) block user-facing retries by applying retry-after headers and circuit-breaker for that tenant, (2) run audit rehydrate from raw event store for acct-74b2 to recover missing logs, (3) perform immediate least-privilege sweep on scim-sync service account and scope down to only necessary KMS keys, (4) sync with billing to credit customer for spike.

maria_support: I'll notify customer: short note that we're investigating, opened INC-2026-0315-01, will share timeline and credits after root cause. If infra/security want me to join the postmortem, ping me. :wave:

sara_eng-iam: I'll prepare a minimal repro patch and a temporary RBAC lock to remove tenant-admin from scim-sync while we triage. Posting PR link when ready.

dan_infra: Will follow up with HSM vendor trace id and post the stack traces here. For now I've paused backfill workers touching acct-74b2.

lee_security: Thanks. Keeping channel for updates only. If anyone needs to add logs, paste them inline or attach to INC ticket.

maria_support: Noted. I'll update customer in 30 mins. :+1:
